title: Practice: Rear Knee
source: Practice Mode tutorial. Words from the app's Technique Library (practiceData.js › Muay Thai › Rear Knee: cues, mistakes, next); the same video serves the Kickboxing and MMA Rear Knee entries and the Muay Thai path's Knee lesson. Thai: khao trong (เข่าตรง), the straight knee. Footage: the owner's clip 26 (ring, 2026-11-03), raw-footage/practice/p26.mp4, three shots joined in InShot (soft joins at 2.93 and 5.5 s, found by the body jumping across the frame): a step in and a rear knee at 1.3, 4.0, 6.2 and 8.8 s, all facing the camera.

props.description: Rear-leg knee strike with full hip drive

cues.label: STEP IN
cues.say: Coach: "Knees land close. Step the lead foot in first, then the knee comes."

cues.label: HIPS
cues.say: Coach: "The hip pushes forward and the knee rides it. Lean back a touch for the drive."

cues.label: TARGET
cues.say: Coach: "Ribs, liver, solar plexus. The point of the knee into the body."

watch.fix: Hips through, not just knee up
watch.label: HIPS
watch.say: Coach: "Lift the knee without the hip and it's a tap. Push the hips through and it folds them."
